podcast.body: This song was created by rapper Montero Hill (Lil Nas X), who, being "desperate" and seeing it as his "last shot," purchased a remix of Nine Inch Nails' "34 Ghosts 4" from Dutch beatmaker YoungKio. It hit number one worldwide and spent a record 19 weeks at the top of the Billboard Hot 100, making Lil Nas X an international superstar. Due to commercial use of the Creative Commons-licensed "34 Ghosts 4," Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross received official songwriting credits and shared the song's chart records. "The song was Old Town Road. It hit number one of the charts around the world, spending a record 19 weeks at the top of the Billboard Hot 100."

podcast.body: This song became a massive global hit, staying at number one on the Billboard singles charts for 19 consecutive weeks, setting an all-time record. Lil Nas X, living in Atlanta and unaware of Nine Inch Nails, bought a beat for $30 online from Young Kioh, a Dutch producer. The beat was based on "34 Ghosts 4" from Nine Inch Nails' 2008 instrumental album "Ghosts 1-4." After the song's success, a quiet settlement was reached, resulting in Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross of Nine Inch Nails, along with Young Kioh, receiving songwriting credits and a share of the profits and Grammy wins. "It stayed at number one on the Billboard singles charts for 19 consecutive weeks, which is an all-time record."
